scenes.stage_direction: The household's polished public account meets the records retained by its workers. Amara speaks for herself.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: He wanted Ethan's place in the family kept out of the records.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Victor wanted money. Kellan wanted a name to disappear.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: A relative has offered to help, but there is a condition.

metadata.evidence_summary: His motive is distinct from Victor's financial grievance.
